verdicts.reason: The two layouts are almost the same: the headline is reflowed to 4 lines with a good size step, and the CTA is kept, but in both the LIMITED badge sits about 40px from the left edge, so it looks pushed out of the centred axis and crowds the edge. The CTA is also tight under the headline while a large dead orange band fills the bottom. A sits higher, with about 60px at the top and about 170px of empty space at the bottom, so it is more top-heavy; B's block is a little lower and better balanced vertically, which makes it marginally better.
